security_implications: This chunk aggregates error valid signals from multiple sources and unconditionally asserts hw2reg.err_code.de. Any spuriously asserted error source can trigger an error interrupt and error code capture. The de signal is level-sensitive and combinational, risking glitches or prolonged assertion that may cause incorrect security response handling. The missing d-drive for err_code could result in undefined error data being recorded.
